_note: The model never types an author, a title or a year. It returns an id and a claim index, and code substitutes the strings below. That makes a fabricated citation structurally impossible rather than merely unlikely, which matters because a made-up study on a psychology page is the one mistake there is no recovering from. Claims are pre-written for the same reason: a real source can still be misrepresented. Every line here must pass source_is_specific() in audit_copy.py, which the test suite asserts.
